workItems.objective: Assemble one complete assignment candidate and promote it through SpecialistAssignmentGate.

included: Require exactly one profile for every approved work item.
Reject the full candidate if any item is unassignable.
excluded: Partial baselines, scheduling, readiness calculation, execution, or DAG mutation.

checks.method: Exercise complete, missing, duplicate, ineligible, stale, modified-byte, and replay promotion fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Only one complete exact assignment set can become the approved baseline; partial assignment never progresses.

required-evidence.description: Only one complete exact assignment set can become the approved baseline; partial assignment never progresses.

workItems.objective: Provide exact versioned specialist, capability, tool, grant, and assignment-policy inputs.

included: Define closed catalogs and policy fixtures.
Fail closed for unknown profiles, capabilities, tools, grants, and policy versions.
excluded: Availability, scheduling, concrete model selection, or runtime credentials.

dependency-hints.rationale: Catalogs and policy must conform to the canonical input contracts.

checks.method: Exercise valid, stale, missing, and unknown catalog and policy references.
checks.successCriteria: Every accepted catalog and policy input is exact, versioned, content-bound, and fail-closed.

required-evidence.description: Every accepted catalog and policy input is exact, versioned, content-bound, and fail-closed.

workItems.objective: Define the provider-neutral SpecialistAssignment artifacts, module surface, and ranker port.

included: Define closed invocation, eligibility, candidate, Gate, and traceability contracts.
Keep concrete runtimes and providers outside the canonical assignment contract.
excluded: Scheduling, readiness selection, runtime binding, or work execution.

checks.method: Validate positive, negative, unknown-field, and provider-substitution fixtures.
checks.successCriteria: Only closed provider-neutral planning contracts validate and no execution authority crosses the ranker port.

required-evidence.description: Only closed provider-neutral planning contracts validate and no execution authority crosses the ranker port.

workItems.objective: Document SpecialistAssignment configuration, boundaries, artifacts, outcomes, and extension points.

included: Explain Core eligibility, replaceable ranking, Gate, traceability, and downstream runtime binding.
State clearly that assignment does not build or execute work.
excluded: Claiming concrete provider availability or execution completion.

dependency-hints.rationale: Documentation should cite final verified behavior.

checks.method: Review documentation against approved requirements, architecture, contracts, and release evidence.
checks.successCriteria: Operators can configure and audit assignment without confusing profile assignment with execution.

required-evidence.description: Operators can configure and audit assignment without confusing profile assignment with execution.

workItems.objective: Implement Core-owned hard eligibility evaluation for every approved work item.

included: Evaluate required capabilities, tools, grants, and policy.
Return deterministic eligible sets and evidence-backed rejection reasons.
excluded: Ranking eligible profiles or approving an assignment candidate.

dependency-hints.rationale: Eligibility consumes exact validated catalogs and policy.

checks.method: Replay shuffled inputs and mutate every hard requirement and policy binding.
checks.successCriteria: Core produces stable eligible sets or exact fail-closed diagnostics without calling a ranker.

required-evidence.description: Core produces stable eligible sets or exact fail-closed diagnostics without calling a ranker.

workItems.objective: Implement the default native structured ranker over Core-supplied eligible profiles.

included: Select exactly one eligible profile per work item.
Return deterministic rationale through the bounded ranker port.
excluded: Changing eligibility, creating profiles, scheduling work, or binding a concrete runtime.

dependency-hints.rationale: The ranker receives only Core-approved eligible sets.

checks.method: Replay equivalent eligible sets in randomized order and reject out-of-set selections.
checks.successCriteria: The native ranker deterministically selects exactly one supplied eligible profile and cannot expand authority.

required-evidence.description: The native ranker deterministically selects exactly one supplied eligible profile and cannot expand authority.

workItems.objective: Publish optional ranker adapters behind the same provider-neutral port.

included: Declare bounded adapter capabilities and normalize native output.
Prove adapter substitution uses identical canonical input and output contracts.
excluded: Making an optional adapter a Core dependency or eligibility authority.

deliverables.description: Optional ranker adapter manifests and fixtures.

dependency-hints.rationale: Adapters must conform to the exact ranker port.

checks.method: Normalize optional-adapter fixtures and compare authority and contract behavior with the native ranker.
checks.successCriteria: Adapters are replaceable without Core branches, graph access, or eligibility authority.

required-evidence.description: Adapters are replaceable without Core branches, graph access, or eligibility authority.

workItems.objective: Project candidate and approved assignments through trusted forward-only contributors.

included: Derive assignment relationships from validated domain references.
Persist update digest, execution identity, graph version, and checkpoint proof.
excluded: Graph access or arbitrary relationship selection by ranker adapters.

deliverables.description: Candidate and approved assignment contributors with merge proof.

dependency-hints.rationale: Approved projection requires the exact Gate-approved assignment baseline.

checks.method: Project, validate, atomically merge, replay, and query candidate and approved assignment relationships.
checks.successCriteria: Only trusted forward assignment facts enter TraceabilityGraph with reproducible merge proof.

required-evidence.description: Only trusted forward assignment facts enter TraceabilityGraph with reproducible merge proof.

workItems.objective: Release-gate SpecialistAssignment across contracts, eligibility, ranking, Gate, traceability, and packaging.

included: Run focused and full regressions, replay, drift, authority, substitution, and package checks.
Prove the module assigns profiles without executing work.
excluded: Runtime provider binding, scheduling, or work execution.

dependency-hints.rationale: Gate behavior must be available for end-to-end verification.
Traceability behavior must be available for end-to-end verification.

checks.method: Run the canonical package gate, module dogfood replay, mutation tests, and independent contract review.
checks.successCriteria: All release gates pass deterministically with complete assignments and no execution authority.

required-evidence.description: All release gates pass deterministically with complete assignments and no execution authority.
